ideas.pitch: A lightweight monitoring agent designed for hybrid infrastructure that tracks anomalies locally and syncs insights over intermittent connections.
ideas.title: HybridEdge Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the hybrid nature of the event directly with a working infrastructure tool that appeals to technical judges looking for robust systems engineering.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined asset management dashboard for solo creators to organize media assets locally and push updates instantly across hybrid storage providers.
ideas.title: QuickSync Asset Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a polished, working demo that solves an immediate workflow bottleneck for individual developers and creators.

ideas.pitch: A speed-first Markdown note-taking application featuring zero-config hybrid sync using peer-to-peer data channels for absolute reliability during offline sessions.
ideas.title: LocalFirst Notes
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard engineering in local-first data synchronization and offline-first state management within a short timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A rapid time-series analysis tool built to ingest local telemetry data and output probabilistic trend forecasts using lightweight statistical regression.
ideas.title: SignalPulse Forecast
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the analytical depth of the Apart Research AI Forecasting win by delivering calibrated prediction intervals in a clean notebook interface.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision utility that processes local video feeds to detect structural compliance anomalies on-device with high frame-rate performance.
ideas.title: EdgeMetrics Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning pattern of computer vision automation applied to industrial and physical monitoring tasks.
